channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Honeywell and Ecolab Discuss AI's Limits in the Physical World
item.description: Honeywell CTO Suresh Venkatarayalu said customers demand near-perfect accuracy, while frontier models may reach only 85%.

item.title: ServiceNow Executive Cites AI Agents Delivering Life-Changing Results at Standard Chartered
item.description: Paul Fipps, ServiceNow's president of global customer operations, told Fortune's AIQ Summit that some clients cannot rely on humans to keep AI agents in check.

item.title: Richard Florida Addresses 189,000 Job Losses, Says AI Both Enhances and Eliminates Work
item.description: New York has lost a quarter of its film jobs. The urbanist who coined the term creative class says AI will make cities matter more, not less.

item.title: ServiceNow AIQ data shows training gap between AI leaders and laggards
item.description: Pacesetters are more likely to hire and train staff. ServiceNow's Diana David says it is not just about technology.
